prompt: A manufacturing company produces an item at a base cost of $80. A retail store purchases these items and marks them up by 60% to determine its initial selling price. During a promotional event, a customer buys the item at a 25% discount off the initial selling price. Additionally, an 8% sales tax is applied to the discounted price for the customer. The retail store incurs a $5 handling fee for each item sold, which is added to their operational costs. What is the net profit for the retail store from the sale of one such item?
